description.content: Use this REST API to create and delete auto policy waiver exclusions.

Use this method to create an auto policy waiver exclusion for a specified auto policy waiver.

Permissions required: Waive Policy Violations

variable.description: (Required) Enter the ownerType to specify which resource type owns the auto waiver you want to apply a exclusion to. Possible values are application, organization.
(Required) Enter the corresponding id for the ownerType specified above.

response.name: Auto policy waiver exclusion has been created successfully.

Use this method to delete an auto policy waiver exclusion, specified by the autoPolicyWaiverExclusionId.

Permissions required: Waive Policy Violations

variable.description: (Required) Enter the ownerType to specify the scope. A waiver exclusion corresponding to the autoPolicyWaiverExclusionId provided and within the scope specified will be deleted.
(Required) Enter the corresponding id for the ownerType specified above.
(Required) Enter the relevant Auto Policy Waiver ID.
(Required) Enter the autoPolicyWaiverId to be deleted

response.name: Auto policy waiver exclusion has been deleted successfully.
